newsitem.title: UK: Salomon hires James Capel transport analysts.
newsitem.headline: Salomon hires James Capel transport analysts.

text.p: Transport analysts Nick Anderson and Matthew Owen have quit HSBC James Capel to join Salomon Brothers, the U.S. brokerage said on Tuesday.
Salomon said the two would cover the European transport industry and will report to head of equity research Dr Albert Richards.
"With the hiring of Nick and Matthew we create coverage of yet another important sector in equity research," Richards said.

"The team has been ranked runner-up in the Institutional Investor survey both in 1995 and 1996 as well as being rated number three with Extel and number four with the Reuters survey for coverage of the UK transport sector in 1996."
"Their appointments add significant strength to our existing equity research team, which has trebled in the last 12 months."
Anderson had been at Capel for four years. Owen was at Capel for just a year after joining the brokerage from Robert Fleming.
